# Chaeboxi

> Local-first, GPLv3 AI copilot. Bring your own keys. Chats stay on your device.

Chaeboxi is an independent desktop-primary copilot (web and mobile exist). It is not Chatbox AI, not a hosted LLM, and not a license marketplace.

## Pages

- [Home](https://nikethai.github.io/chaeboxi/): Product overview, desktop tools, comparison, FAQ
- [Why](https://nikethai.github.io/chaeboxi/why/): Why the desktop app is the product — local-first, BYOK, not Chatbox
- [Download](https://nikethai.github.io/chaeboxi/download/): macOS, Windows, and Linux installers from GitHub Releases
- [Privacy](https://nikethai.github.io/chaeboxi/privacy/): On-device chats, BYOK keys, no marketing cookies
- [Terms](https://nikethai.github.io/chaeboxi/terms/): GNU GPLv3, no warranty
- [Source](https://github.com/nikethai/chaeboxi)
- [Releases](https://github.com/nikethai/chaeboxi/releases)
- [NOTICE](https://github.com/nikethai/chaeboxi/blob/main/NOTICE)

## Facts

- License: GNU GPLv3
- Model: BYOK — OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama, OpenRouter, Azure, xAI, Groq, Mistral, DeepSeek, Qwen, MiniMax, Moonshot, LM Studio, Perplexity, SiliconFlow
- Storage: chats and settings stay on the device or platform storage you choose
- No first-party hosted Chaeboxi chat backend
- Desktop-only: MCP stdio, OS keychain, computer use, browser agent, local E5 knowledge base
- Web and mobile share chat and settings; they do not get those native desktop tools
- Installers: GitHub Releases for macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel), Windows NSIS, Linux AppImage and .deb
